_comment: POS and KDS ship as a SYNCHRONIZED PAIR: identical versionName and
versionCode, always built from one source commit. build_official_pair.ps1
reads nextOfficialRelease and refuses to build anything else.
expectedCertificateSha256 is the PUBLIC fingerprint of the production
signing certificate. It is intentionally committed: it is not a secret, and
pinning it here is what lets a build prove it was signed by the real key
rather than by the Android debug key or an unknown replacement.
Format: colon-separated UPPERCASE hex, exactly as keytool prints it.
check_signing_identity.ps1 compares this value directly against keytool;
verify_official_apk.ps1 strips the colons and lowercases before comparing
against apksigner. Do not change the representation.
NOTE: this is the CERTIFICATE fingerprint. It is a different value from the
SHA-256 of the keystore FILE. Keystore-file hashes, key paths, backup
locations and passwords are deliberately NOT recorded here.
Artifact SHA-256 values below are of the released APK files and are safe to
publish - they are what a reviewer checks an artifact against.
signingCertificateSubject: CN=RestoFlow Android Production, OU=Mobile Release, O=RestoFlow, C=IL

currentOfficialRelease.status: built / Production-signed / POS installed (update-in-place over v26) on SALEH-POS-TEST-01 / KDS not installed / not uploaded / not distributed
notes: Built pre-merge from release-branch HEAD 6a82ec8 (application source
b670b59a = the PR #202 reconnect/payment/pre-bill merge + ledger/docs
only); PR #203 merged that ledger branch into main at c5a0407, making
the candidate the official v27. First Android release containing the
PR #202 fixes for the three v26 acceptance defects.
POS v27 was installed 2026-08-07 on the personal test tablet
SALEH-POS-TEST-01 as an UPDATE-IN-PLACE over official v26 (same
package id, same production certificate, versionCode 27 > 26).
Preserved through the update: the existing pairing (station record
'SALEHPOS ONEPLUS'), the restaurant خرائط البرجر, the branch
كفرمندا, and the printer configuration. Initial Online state was
healthy.
FOCUSED PHYSICAL ACCEPTANCE MATRIX PASSED on v27 - the three v26
defects are confirmed fixed on real hardware:
(1) automatic reconnect: with the app kept open, restoring Wi-Fi
cleared the yellow Offline banner automatically - no app restart;
(2) Offline unpaid pre-bill printing worked correctly while Offline;
(3) payment gating: before synchronization the payment action was
unavailable for the Offline-created controlled order, and after
reconnection the same order synchronized and the payment button
appeared automatically without restart; one controlled payment was
completed exactly once on that same order. The order appeared exactly
once - no duplicate order was observed, and no duplicate customer
pre-bill was printed.
A single controlled low-value unpaid Offline order was used for the
whole matrix; Offline cold start and the cached menu remained usable
as on v26. The payment method and receipt/order identifiers were not
captured in the validation notes and are deliberately not recorded
here.
KDS v27 was built and verified but NOT installed on any device; no
KDS physical validation is claimed.
The operational restaurant tablet was NOT touched; no validation is
claimed for it.
Not uploaded, not distributed, no GitHub Release; artifact files stay
local and git-ignored - only their public SHA-256 values are recorded.

notes: Built pre-merge from release-branch HEAD e62cc54 (application source
2b05204f = the PR #200 Offline Operations merge + ledger/docs only);
PR #201 merged at bd3b75d. First official pair containing Offline
Operations.
POS v26 was installed 2026-08-07 on SALEH-POS-TEST-01 as the FIRST
production-certificate UPDATE-IN-PLACE (over official v25); pairing
(station 'SALEHPOS ONEPLUS'), restaurant خرائط البرجر, branch
كفرمندا, employee access, printer configuration and shift state all
survived; initial Online launch and synchronization were healthy.
Offline foundation PASSED on v26: true cold-start Offline boot,
cached menu/modifiers, the Offline banner, a locally saved unpaid
order, and local kitchen printing.
THREE DEFECTS were discovered on v26 during physical validation:
(1) after connectivity returned, remote assets recovered but the
Offline state stayed latched until a full app restart; (2) the
Offline-created order remained payment-blocked after reconnect
because server acceptance/reconciliation was not represented in the
payment gate; (3) the unpaid customer pre-bill could not be printed
Offline even though kitchen printing worked.
All three were fixed client-side by PR #202, merged into main at
b670b59a92ae7d7e5237a77e751ff84d34fabf2a - the v27 application
source. v26 did NOT pass the final Offline reconnect/payment/
pre-bill acceptance matrix; v27 did. v26 is not a failed release:
it proved the foundational Offline architecture on real hardware.
KDS v26 was built and verified but never installed.
Superseded in place by official v27 on 2026-08-07.
